title: Many draws, little effective data
hook: Two stated cases: explore the mean-variance ESS of an explicit correlation model.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the mean-variance ESS of an explicit correlation model affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines ESS, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the mean-variance ESS of an explicit correlation model in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
